attributes.board_name: Connecticut Board of Examiners for Nursing / Department of Public Health

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses offered or approved by ANA, Connecticut Hospital Association, Connecticut Nurses Association, Connecticut League for Nursing, a specialty nursing society or equivalent, hospital/health-institution offerings, regionally accredited schools or state/local health departments
rules.new_licensee_rule: The 2 hours are due in the first renewal period, then at least once every six years.
rules.audit_note: Keep attendance records or certificates for 3 years after the year completed; produce them within 45 days of a DPH request.
rules.notes: No general hour requirement: licenses renew every year in the birth month; only a 2-hour course is required (at the first renewal, then at least every 6 years) covering screening for PTSD, suicide risk, depression and grief plus suicide prevention.
